_comment: Official Aider --model-metadata-file for the local LM Studio model. Registered into litellm's model DB so aider's sanity check finds max_input_tokens and stops warning + opening the docs page. Values reflect the LOADED server context (lms ps CONTEXT column), NOT the native 32K: declaring more than the server serves causes oversized prompts and API errors (verified live). If you reload the model with a larger context (lms load ... --context-length N), update max_tokens/max_input_tokens to N. Costs are 0: local inference is free.
